single_reference_policy: All retained mechanisms remain MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS or INVARIANT_HYPOTHESIS until controlled transfer validation.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 语言即景观的主标题质量
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: A short display name gains first-read authority when newly authored glyphs form one irregular object with unequal mass and deliberate negative-space cuts, rather than a row of stock characters.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: The display title must behave as one authored graphic mass while remaining legible.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Literal wording, glyph-specific geometry, exact position, surface erosion amount and light-color value may change.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: One source cannot prove how much mass irregularity or erosion can vary before family recognition fails.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: New locked title copy, human character-correctness review, family-distance review and full-image hierarchy review.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Stock bold CJK line, copied source contours, unreadable erosion, or three disconnected glyph blocks.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 主身份—辅助信息—表达/归属的三层阅读场
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: Large scale gaps, separated vertical registers and unequal contrast let identity, support and ownership coexist without becoming one dense information block.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: At least three distinguishable authority levels must survive at thumbnail and normal view.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Exact claim count, copy language, presence of handwriting and footer implementation may change or be omitted.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: The exact minimum number and placement of subordinate tiers are not proven.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Composition and aspect variation with independent thumbnail hierarchy review.
mechanisms.failure_signature: All text groups share similar scale/contrast, duplicated title, or support copy becomes specification-label clutter.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 复杂摄影场中的分级信息对比
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: Text scale and weight are matched to local image luminance/frequency: small information occupies quieter pockets, while the dominant display mass can cross richer texture because it carries more area and contrast.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: Information authority must be locally calibrated to photographic complexity, not applied through one global text treatment.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Photographic subject, palette, exact text color and title location may vary when local contrast roles are preserved.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: No full-image output has yet tested the relationship on another photographic subject or palette.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Full-image content and palette tests; flat-background typography proof is not sufficient.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Small text over busy highlights, artificial dark panels behind every text block, or photo and type reading as unrelated layers.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 近软—中清—远暗的环境纵深框景
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: A soft foreground occluder, readable middle plane and dark receding background turn a full-bleed environment into spatial framing for information.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: The photographic field must contain meaningful depth staging or an equivalent spatial separation mechanism.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Subject species, foreground object identity, blur amount and precise mass positions may change.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: The family may tolerate an equivalent non-photographic depth mechanism, but the current source does not prove that.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Content swap using a different truthful environment while preserving near/mid/far separation.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Flat stock background, uniform sharpness, pasted blur, or foreground obstruction that hides key information.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 连续照片内部的安静信息场
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: Dark and lower-frequency regions inside the photograph function as active negative space, letting microcopy remain integrated without blank boxes.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: Small information must occupy intentionally quiet local fields or an equivalent contrast-safe structure.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Quiet zones may move, change shape or be created through crop, light, focus or image selection.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: The tolerance for brighter or higher-frequency quiet fields is untested.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Measured local contrast/frequency checks on a new content field.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Microcopy over the busiest image regions, blanket shadows behind every label, or passive empty gaps disconnected from hierarchy.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 主标题质量与复杂摄影质量的反向配重
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: The title needs enough area, irregularity and light authority to counterbalance an edge-to-edge active photograph, while leaving enough photographic area for environmental identity.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: Display mass and photographic complexity must be mutually calibrated rather than independently maximized.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Title size and photo density can move within a bounded inverse relationship.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: The acceptable title-area and image-density range is not measured across outputs.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Tiny title swallowed by texture, oversized title erasing the photograph, or both layers competing at maximum density.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 外围微文案的画幅稳定作用
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: Sparse top claim clusters and bottom edge labels distribute small-scale information across the canvas perimeter, stabilizing the broad central title and long vertical field.
mechanisms.fixed_invariant_candidate: Peripheral support may be useful as a counterweight, but literal top/bottom copy is not mandatory.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Count, language, exact edge position and omission may vary if an equivalent peripheral counterweight exists.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: Peripheral microcopy may be replaceable by another counterweight or omitted entirely.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Compare full, reduced and omitted peripheral information in aspect transfer.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Decorative English filler, unreadable edge text, or perimeter labels competing with the identity.

mechanisms.human_readable_name: 有限强调色跨角色连续性
mechanisms.causal_hypothesis: A small repeated accent role can connect identity marker, path and expressive voice when each occurrence has semantic work.
mechanisms.degree_of_freedom_candidate: Accent may change hue, change form, derive from a new subject or be omitted.
mechanisms.known_uncertainty: Later controlled proof rejected the path as stable; only the broader limited-accent relationship remains plausible.
mechanisms.validation_requirement: Subject-derived motif test against an omission control.
mechanisms.failure_signature: Floating scribble, arbitrary sticker, generic underline or accent expanded until it becomes a surface template.
